summary: Tested account deletion (backend and UI), the fullscreen route map (admin and driver) and the iOS app.json config on the preview URL at 375x667. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (tests/test_account_deletion.py). Covered: GET check shape, unauthenticated 401, admin can_delete=false, Marcus blocked by route R-101, wrong password/PIN gives 401, unpaid bill and open stop each give 409, successful store and driver deletion (tokens 401, login 401, user anonymised, merchant deleted/disabled with contact and address wiped, invoices kept, driver 'Deleted driver' with phone changed, gone from /api/drivers and /api/admin/driver-accounts). All on throwaway TEST accounts created in Mongo. Frontend: route-map-expand (44x44) opens route-map-fullscreen titled '<route> · PINCH TO ZOOM', the map fills 375x611, and route-map-fullscreen-close (56x56) closes it. Works on /admin/route/route-review and on Marcus's driver screen. driver-delete-account-link (44px tall) shows at the bottom of the manifest and in the NO ROUTE ASSIGNED empty state. For Marcus it opens a sheet with delete-account-blocked ('You still have a route assigned...'); OK, X and the backdrop all close it. books@ merchant-delete-account-link opens the sheet listing 2 blockers (2 open bills CA$56.50 and 7 open deliveries). The link is hidden when admin views mer-2. Full UI deletion of a throwaway store and driver signs out, and signing in again fails ('Wrong email or password' / 'Wrong phone number or PIN'). CRITICAL BUG: a wrong password or PIN in the delete sheet signs the user out instead of showing the error, because src/api.ts clears the session on any 401. app.json is valid JSON and has every iOS setting that was requested. No deprecated Expo packages found. No page errors.

minor.issue: A wrong secret returns 401. The frontend api() helper treats every 401 as an expired session and signs the user out (see integration_issues). Consider returning 403 or 400 for a wrong password/PIN, or exclude this path on the frontend.
No lockout or rate limit on secret checks. Anyone holding a stolen session token can try PINs (1M combinations) with no limit. Reuse check_lockout/record_failure.

Every active store automatically gets an unpaid monthly platform-fee invoice (CA$28.25) for the current month. Observed: a brand-new TEST store was issued DL-000029 within minutes of opening the portal, and that immediately blocked deletion ('Pay your 1 open bill'). In practice every store has to pay the current month's fee before it can delete. That follows the 'block on unpaid bills' choice, but Apple's 5.1.1(v) review may see it as deletion behind a paywall. Consider excluding the current month's platform invoice, or voiding it on deletion.

ui_bugs.issue: Entering a wrong password (store) or wrong PIN (driver) and tapping DELETE MY ACCOUNT signs the user out and sends them to the sign-in screen. delete-account-error ('That password is wrong' / 'That PIN is wrong') never shows. RCA: frontend/src/api.ts:136 calls clearSession() on any 401 when a token is present. The backend returns 401 for a wrong secret (routes/account.py:52). Reproduced for both the merchant and the driver; the backend log shows 'POST /api/me/delete-account 401'.

integration_issues.issue: The 401 is read as session expiry, so the user is logged out. Fix: return 403 (or 400) from the backend for a wrong secret, or skip clearSession for path '/me/delete-account' in api.ts.

issues: The unpaid-bill blocker says '... first — Billing below.', but the sheet opens from the link at the very bottom of the portal and the Billing (InvoicesCard) section is ABOVE it. Use 'in Billing above' or 'in the Billing section'.
No confirmation is shown. The user lands on the sign-in screen with no 'Your account was deleted' message. Add a toast or notice on the sign-in screen.
The 44x44 expand button in the top-right corner can cover a stop marker. On route-review, marker 3 sits under it.
The store link says 'DELETE MY STORE ACCOUNT' but the sheet title and button say 'DELETE MY ACCOUNT'. This is minor and only for consistency.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the wrong password/PIN in DeleteAccountSheet signing the user out. Either return 403 from POST /api/me/delete-account for a wrong secret (routes/account.py:52, and update the tests), or exclude '/me/delete-account' from the 401 -> clearSession rule in src/api.ts:136.

MEDIUM: Decide whether the auto-issued current-month platform fee should block deletion. Every store currently has one open, so deletion is effectively blocked until it pays (App Store 5.1.1(v) risk).
LOW: Add a lockout or rate limit on POST /api/me/delete-account secret attempts.
LOW: Change the blocker copy 'Billing below' to 'Billing above' or 'in the Billing section'.
LOW: Show a confirmation after a successful deletion.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.ts:136 treats every 401 as session expiry. Any endpoint that returns 401 for a credential re-check will log the user out.
RouteMap.tsx:29 falls back to San Francisco (37.7749,-122.4194) when there are no markers. The app is Kitchener-Waterloo; use the depot coordinates.

account.py: merchant deletion disables only role=merchant users for the store, which is correct. Deleted merchants still show in admin GET /api/merchants with deleted:true; that is fine for admin history, but the admin UI should mark them.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows work except the wrong-secret error path, which signs the user out)

Pytest creates and cleans up its own mer-deltest-*/drv-deltest-* by id. A leftover: platform invoice DL-000029 (id ed0eacc7-08f0-4ced-9c11-ea9d028491a2, merchant mer-deltest-c3df52df), auto-issued by ensure_platform_invoices. It was marked paid in Mongo and kept so the invoice numbering has no gap. A pre-existing drv-deltest-91225d (deleted=true) and a mer-deltest from the main agent's run are still in the DB. No demo accounts were changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_account_deletion.py -v. UI seed: python tests/ui_seed_deltest.py (prints sfx, email; password TEST_Pw_123!; driver PIN 583917), then 'python tests/ui_seed_deltest.py cleanup <sfx>'. The platform invoice is auto-issued when the portal loads, so mark it paid before testing the can-delete UI. The admin dashboard route list is date-scoped (R-101 isn't listed today); click the first [data-testid^=admin-route-]. Wait about 1.2 s after the sheet opens before clicking delete-account-close (slide animation).
rca_of_issue: Wrong secret -> logout: account.py:52 raises HTTPException(401). src/api.ts:136 runs clearSession() when res.status===401 and a token exists (only /auth/login and /track/ are excluded), so the session is wiped and the router redirects to sign-in. Repro: sign in as a throwaway store, open the delete sheet, enter a wrong password, tap DELETE MY ACCOUNT, and you land on /sign-in/merchant. Fix: return 403 for a wrong secret, or exclude the path.
